**Edge situation 1 — the app can't read a page's details.** This *will* happen: some pages are private, behind a login, momentarily down, or just don't publish a title. Since our saving flow leans on auto-filling those details, we should agree on what you see when it can't.

Here's one way to handle it — open **http://maker:4001/edge-fetch.html**. The link is still saved (nothing is lost), but instead of a title it falls back to showing the **web address**, with a small amber note: *"Couldn't load this page's title or description automatically."* 

Please **click "＋ Add a title yourself"** and give it a recognizable name — so even when the automatic fill fails, you can still make the link findable by hand.

Two things to tell me:
- Is **"still save it, show the address, and let me add a title myself"** the behaviour you'd want here — as opposed to, say, refusing to save it at all?
- The description and icon would simply stay blank in this case. Is that acceptable, or would you want something else in their place?
